name: Fort Sumter
elevationDatum: Local y=0 is the visual island waterline; courtyard at y=1.2 m, raised eastern earth fill at y=5.2 m. These are relative estimated site levels, not a tide or DEM datum. Rigid masonry and Battery Huger must remain fixed; no terrain or Mercator scale baked in.
note: Present-day ruined fort, not an 1861 three-tier reconstruction. OSM outer wall, island and Huger footprints; HABS SC-194 gives surviving wall about 15.5 ft above ground and 5 ft thick; NPS NRHP inventory gives Battery Huger 270 × 90 × 22 ft. Current OSM enclosure is larger than HABS approximate historic side lengths; retained mapped outline, no claim they agree. Variable ruin heights, exact casemate layouts, earth-fill level, flagpoles and parapet details estimated from photographs.
